base_link_analysis.verdict: mass = 2700 kg/m^3 x V_local EXACTLY (0.089143 m^3 solid box); provenance = geometric calculation with aluminum density, NOT a weighed value and NOT identified content

geometry_capabilities.api: Blender 5.0.1 has NO Mesh.calc_volume / calc_center_of_mass / calc_inertia; tetrahedron decomposition used (scale-aware)
geometry_capabilities.com: COMPUTED (world) - base COM matches bbox center exactly
geometry_capabilities.inertia: COMPUTED and VALIDATED: base_link Ixx=8.5305 vs analytic box 8.5232 kg m^2 (delta 0.09% = local/world scale factor); all diagonal elements positive after barycentric fix
geometry_capabilities.scale_handling: world-space computation includes matrix_parent_inverse scales (arm chains det=1.977-1.979, palm 2.496); obj.scale ALONE DOES NOT reveal this (reports ~1.0)
geometry_capabilities.parametric_rule: unknown thickness/material -> keep m = rho*A(t), I = f(rho, t) symbolic, no fabricated numbers
